caption: The drawing depicts a wooden half-moon console table with three turned legs. The tabletop is semicircular, shown with brown tones and wood grain texture, with highlights and shading indicating a polished surface. Below the colored perspective illustration of the table, there are two additional black-and-white line drawings: one is a front elevation with labeled dimensions showing the height (30 3/8 inches) and the other a plan view showing the top's semicircular shape, labeled with the width (48 1/2 inches) and depth (24 1/4 inches). The drawing is on a cream-colored background with the artist’s signature at the lower right corner.
title: Bishop Hill: Table
